verdict.rationale: Gitea's own site says it runs on Linux, Windows, macOS, FreeBSD and Kubernetes, on x86 and arm64. Community reports back this up: one user found the Docker setup smooth for a 45-person team, and others describe it as a single binary that runs fine on VPSes and low-end hardware. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party install docs per OS/architecture (the evidence is marketing-level claims), documentation of an official container image, and independent confirmation of the non-Linux and arm64 deployments.
